story.titleZh: 拉塞尔险胜维斯塔潘夺阿塞拜疆大奖赛冠军 安东内利两度安全车助力从第16位恢复至第5位
story.summaryZh: 乔治·拉塞尔在阿塞拜疆大奖赛中以0.196秒的微弱优势击败马克斯·维斯塔潘，结束了个人F1的冠军荒；领跑积分榜的基米·安东内利从第16位恢复到第5位，部分得益于两次事故引发的安全车。
story.originalTitle: Russell denies Verstappen in Azerbaijan GP punctuated by two safety cars
story.summaryEn: George Russell ended his Formula 1 victory drought at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix by beating Max Verstappen by just 0.196 seconds, while championship leader Kimi Antonelli recovered from 16th to fifth, aided in part by two safety cars triggered by crashes.
detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上终结了长期无缘一级方程式胜利的尴尬纪录，仅以0.196秒的优势击败马克斯·维斯塔潘，而积分榜领跑者安东内利则从第16位回升至第5位，这在一定程度上要归功于两次因撞车而出动的安全车。
拉塞尔做到了在一条带有长直道的街道赛道上领跑者应该做的一切：他起步出色，立即摆脱了一秒超车窗口的束缚，并且在第一次进站时已将领先优势扩大到12秒。
他在比赛早期最令人担心的是，在全场51圈的第25圈于15号弯出口“轻蹭”了护墙，但除此之外他一路顺畅无阻，直到第31圈亚历克斯·阿尔本在4号弯撞车，抹去了他的优势。
这次安全车让拉塞尔的队友安东内利受益最大。
积分榜领跑者安东内利从第16位发车，发车时实际上还丢了一个位置，随后他用了17圈超越七辆赛车，进入了积分区。虽然他的推进速度不如他在蒙扎从第19位发车逆转夺冠时那么快，但他采取了规避风险、更加稳健的策略，很可能是考虑到积分榜领跑者的身份。
他追上了佛朗哥·科拉平托并完成超越，先抹掉了不到四秒的差距拿下第九，随后又因兰多·诺里斯令人失望的比赛继续而获赠第八——这位迈凯伦车手在1号弯因抱死直接冲出了赛道。
安全车出动时，安东内利位居第八，落后拉塞尔35秒，但安全车将全场车阵收拢，给了他更好的推进机会，并让他得以换上更有优势的软胎。
重启时，随着1号弯爆发大规模混战，他立即上升了一个名次。
科拉平托出现了非常严重、近乎滑稽的锁死，撞上了阿尔派的队友加斯利——加斯利在重启时排在第七位——同时还将诺里斯撞出比赛，而利亚姆·劳森也在身后由阿维德·林德布拉德引发的连锁追尾效应中被撞得打转。劳森讽刺地说：“我可真喜欢被自己的队友撞出比赛。”阿尔派在这场混乱中失去了双车积分完的机会，这让加斯利非常不满，科拉平托也为此道歉。
在身后跟着维斯塔潘这一最大压力的情况下，拉塞尔在第39圈的重启中表现得非常出色，但维斯塔潘在之后的整整三圈内仍然保持着可以尝试超车的距离，随后维斯塔潘做出了全场最快圈速，重新逼近——拒绝接受失败。
一直到最后两圈，维斯塔潘都保持在攻击范围之内，不断给拉塞尔施压，直到拉塞尔终于拉开了1.4秒的差距，但在最后一圈，当两人都驶过博塔斯撞车的凯迪拉克所留下的事故现场后，维斯塔潘又重新追了上来，冲向终点线。
但拉塞尔最终还是守住了，这是他自六月底的奥地利大奖赛以来的首场胜利。
“双黄旗之后我就失去了增压，也没有动力了，”拉塞尔在赛后说道。
维斯塔潘在比赛初期从他第八位的发车位一路向前推进，尽管他和他的工程师之间就中性胎有过一些争论，并且早期还受到伊萨克·哈贾尔的猛烈施压，但他还是跑出了一场精彩的比赛，拿下第二名。他在第一次安全车重启后就已经超越了奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里，升至第二。
哈贾尔在因伤缺席三场比赛后，取得了令人惊叹的第三名，他在比赛初期明显速度更快，并且作为一名出色的队友，主动提出留在维斯塔潘身后。
获得第四名的夏尔·勒克莱尔先后被两辆红牛超越，看起来节奏不佳，当天很难登上领奖台；而如果不是皮亚斯特里在第一号弯因抱死轮胎冲出赛道缓冲区、自己退出了争夺，情况本可能更糟，这进一步加剧了迈凯伦令人失望的一天。
安东内利的赛车地板在第一次安全车重启时被奥利·贝尔曼碰到后受损，起初很难超越刘易斯·汉密尔顿，但最终在第二次重启五圈后于1号弯完成超越，此后再无提升，以第五名完赛，又一次上演了逆转表现。
汉密尔顿是前十名中除拉塞尔之外唯一一位以发车位完赛的车手，这或许反映出法拉利的比赛节奏存在问题。
在他身后，由阿尔派引发的事故造成了混乱，使一大批本已无缘积分区的赛车重新加入了争夺。
近日备受关注的埃斯特班·奥孔可能正在失去他在哈斯的车手席位，但他在两次安全车之间超越了队友贝尔曼，不过在最后一圈仅以0.030秒之差被击败——林德布拉德在终点线上抢走了那个位置。他因与劳森的碰撞事故免于处罚，并抓住机会完成了一些超车，在一个艰难的周末中尽力争取，最终获得第七名。
奥孔获得第八名，排在贝尔曼之前，而升级后的威廉姆斯车队则由卡洛斯·塞恩斯拿下了一个积分，他在早期进站后一度排名低至第19位。
霍肯伯格以第11名与积分失之交臂，排在他前面的是劳森、加布里埃尔·博托莱托、皮亚斯特里和塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯。
detailEn: George Russell ended a barren run without a Formula 1 victory in the Azerbaijan Grand Prix by just 0.196s over Max Verstappen, with championship leader Kimi Antonelli recovering to fifth from 16th in part thanks to a pair of safety cars for crashes.

Russell did everything a leader on a street circuit with a long straight on it should do: he got a good start, immediately cleared the one-second overtake window, and had extended his lead to 12 seconds by the time of the first pit stops.
His biggest early cause for concern was "nibbling" the wall at the exit of Turn 15 on lap 25 of 51, but he otherwise ran untroubled until Alex Albon crashing at Turn 4 on lap 31 erased his advantage.
The safety car benefitted Russell's team-mate Kimi Antonelli most.

Championship leader Antonelli started 16th and actually lost a spot at the start, then took 17 laps to pass seven cars and make it to the points-paying positions. While his progress wasn't as rapid as his comeback win at Monza from 19th, it was risk-averse and steadier with the championship lead likely in mind.

He caught and passed Franco Colapinto after erasing a just under four-second gap for ninth and then was gifted eighth when Lando Norris's disappointing race continued as the McLaren driver went straight on with a lock-up at Turn 1.

At the point of the safety car Antonelli was eighth and 35s off Russell, but the safety car bunched the field to give him a better chance of progressing and allowed him to switch to the favoured soft tyre.
He immediately made up a place on the restart as a massive melee broke out at Turn 1.

A massive, near-comical lock-up from Colapinto smashed him into Alpine team-mate Pierre Gasly - who'd been seventh on the restart - and also took Norris out, while Liam Lawson was also spun in the concertina effect behind by Arvid Lindblad. "I love getting taken out by my team-mate," said a sarcastic Lawson, while Alpine lost a double-points finish in the chaos - much to Gasly's displeasure and Colapinto's apologies.

In the highest-pressure scenario of having Verstappen behind, Russell absolutely nailed the restart on lap 39 but Verstappen remained in overtake mode range until three laps later, and then Verstappen set the fastest lap of the race to close back in - refusing to accept defeat.

All the way until two laps to go Verstappen stayed within range and subjected Russell to pressure, until Russell finally built a 1.4s gap, but then Verstappen closed back in on the run to finish line on the final lap once both had cleared the scene of Valtteri Bottas's crashed Cadillac.
But Russell was just able to hold on for his first win since the Austria GP in late-June.
"After the double-yellow I had no boost, had no power," said Russell after the race.

Verstappen charged through the field from his eighth-place starting spot in the early stages, and despite some bickering between himself and his engineer over the mediums, and intense early pressure from Isack Hadjar, drove a fine race to take second. He'd passed Oscar Piastri for second already after the first safety car restart.
Hadjar bagged an amazing result to take third after three races out injured, and was clearly faster in the early stages and played a great team-mate race by offering to stay behind Verstappen.

Fourth-place finisher Charles Leclerc was passed by both the Red Bulls and appeared to struggle for pace, making a podium unlikely on the day, and it could have been worse had Piastri hadn't taken himself out of the battle with a lock-up at the first corner that sent him into the runoff area, compounding McLaren's disappointing day.

Antonelli received damage to his floor after being clipped by Ollie Bearman on the first safety car restart, and initially struggled to clear Lewis Hamilton, but finally got past five laps after the second restart at Turn 1 and went no further, taking fifth in another comeback drive.
Hamilton was the only driver in the top 10 other than Russell to finish where he started, perhaps reflecting Ferrari's race pace struggles.
Behind him, the Alpine-induced crash created chaos and brought a host of cars well out of points contention into play.

In-the-news Esteban Ocon may be losing his Haas seat but vaulted team-mate Bearman between the two safety cars, but then was bested on the last lap by just 0.030s - with Lindblad stealing the spot at the line. He avoided a penalty for the Lawson incident and made some opportunistic overtakes to make the best of a tough weekend with seventh place.
Ocon took eighth ahead of Bearman, while the upgraded Williams bagged a point through Carlos Sainz, who was as low as 19th after his early stop.
Hulkenberg missed out on the point with 11th, ahead of Lawson, Gabriel Bortoleto, Piastri and Sergio Perez.
keyPointsZh: 拉塞尔起步出色，迅速摆脱一秒超车窗口，并在首次进站前将领先优势扩大到12秒。
第25圈拉塞尔在15号弯出口轻微剐蹭护墙，这是他早期最大的隐患。
第31圈亚历克斯·阿尔本在4号弯撞车，抹掉了拉塞尔的领先优势。
keyPointsEn: Russell made a strong start, immediately cleared the one-second overtake window and extended his lead to 12 seconds by the first pit stops.
On lap 25 Russell nibbled the wall at the exit of Turn 15, his biggest early concern.
Alex Albon's crash at Turn 4 on lap 31 erased Russell's advantage.

relatedItems.titleZh: 博塔斯解释巴库站大幅落后佩雷兹的原因
relatedItems.summaryZh: 博塔斯透露，在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上他平均每圈比凯迪拉克队友佩雷兹慢超过1.7秒，是2026赛季迄今正赛中最大的队内差距，他对此表示在直道和弯角都无法跟上节奏。
relatedItems.originalTitle: The slowest race of F1 2026 explained
relatedItems.summaryEn: Valtteri Bottas has revealed why he was on average more than 1.7 seconds per lap slower than his Cadillac team-mate Sergio Perez at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, the largest race-day intra-team deficit of the 2026 season so far.
detailZh: 瓦尔特里·博塔斯透露了上一站巴库比赛中，他相比凯迪拉克F1队友塞尔吉奥·佩雷兹速度严重不足的一些原因。
在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上，博塔斯平均每圈比佩雷兹慢超过1.7秒之多，这是2026赛季迄今正赛中最大的队内差距。甚至他的最快单圈也比佩雷兹慢1.489秒。
博塔斯在最后一圈撞上护墙，因为他在驶过1号弯逃生通道后，赛车的能量输出模式“有点混乱”，而由于多跑了距离，他在进入15号弯左弯时后刹车失效，车头撞上了护墙。
但更令人担忧的是此前惊人的速度差距，在博塔斯撞车之前，佩雷兹几乎已经套了他一圈。
“我理解从外面看起来情况很糟糕，坐在车里感觉也很糟糕，”博塔斯周四在马来西亚说。
“当时根本没办法跟上大部队。我在比赛中尝试了所有办法，也得到了很多关于我在哪里损失时间的反馈。很大一部分是在直道上，但也有相当大的一部分是在整圈的弯道中损失掉的。
“所以我一直在坚持推进直到最后，这也是为什么我在最后一圈进一号弯时锁死了轮胎。
“不过是的，关键问题是在练习中我们就已经看到我的速度不够。我无法像佩雷兹那样以同样的速度过弯，所以我们在排位赛前做了很多改动，包括一些减震器和底板，结果感觉确实好多了。
“但在正赛中，行驶品质又明显衰减了很多……我们这次改动了很多东西，所以我觉得问题在于减震器随温度衰减，还有底板……我们在某些地方仍然缺少一些压力测量点，所以对于气动部件，我还拿不到过去习惯获得的完整信息。
“通过数据你马上就能看出性能是提升还是下降，但现在底板有一些区域我们完全看不见。不过就我个人的感觉而言，更多问题出在行驶品质上——再加上动力转向整个周末都在不断衰减。所以我在整场比赛中真的很难去感受赛车。
“这些因素叠加在一起。而且动力单元的差距可能比我们预想的要大，至少从数据上看是这样。
“理论上我们有一个数字，但那是新引擎对全新引擎，也就是新规格对旧规格的对比。所以，我想就是这些因素叠加的结果。我当时确实相当慢。”
动力单元方面的差异指的是佩雷兹在巴库已经用上了升级版 ADUO 2 法拉利引擎，而博塔斯还没有。
此前这被描述为“细微差别”，但正如博塔斯所说，这次升级的效果可能比最初想象的更大。
博塔斯表示，他的 ADUO 2 引擎能否及时送到、让他能在雪邦赛道使用，可能性是“五五开”；如果赶不上，他就得等到下周的新加坡大奖赛。
他的队友佩雷兹本周末不会使用这套引擎，而是换用自己引擎池中的另一套动力单元，以便把升级版留到更能发挥作用的比赛周末再使用。
佩雷斯解释说：“我们做出了一个我们认为胜算最大的决定。”
“这就是为什么我们会在这里承受一些损失。但我们希望这会有所回报。”
“我们对这个周末并不太乐观。所以我们决定把它省下来。”
正如佩雷斯所暗示的，凯迪拉克的车手们已经为艰难的周末做好了准备，因为雪邦赛道带来了两个凯迪拉克尤其难以应对的挑战：轮胎过热和高速弯角。
正如佩雷兹所解释的，凯迪拉克目前“赛车的下压力严重不足，而且阻力很大”。
“在巴库，我基本上整场比赛都保持在超车模式上，所以才能跟住其他车手，”佩雷兹说。
“但当我超过他们之后，我就只能像个乘客一样，因为我没有直道速度。所以我们有两大问题：下压力不足和很大的阻力。”
“但我们一直都知道，第一年会很艰难。”
detailEn: Valtteri Bottas has revealed some of the reasons behind his woeful lack of pace compared to Cadillac Formula 1 team-mate Sergio Perez last time out in Baku.

Bottas was on average over a whopping 1.7 seconds slower than Perez per lap at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, the largest race day intra-team deficit of 2026 so far. Even his single fastest lap was 1.489s slower than Perez.

Bottas ended up in the wall on the final lap as his car’s deployment pattern “got a bit confused” because he went down the Turn 1 escape road, then because of the extra distance travelled his rear brakes didn’t work going into the Turn 15 left-hander, where he nosed into the barriers.
But what was more worrying was the alarming lack of pace before then, with Perez close to lapping Bottas before the latter's crash.
“I understand it looked pretty bad from the outside and felt pretty bad in the car as well,” Bottas said on Thursday in Malaysia.

“There was just no way to keep up with the pack. I tried everything during the race, and got lots of feedback on where I am losing the time. A lot of it was on the straights, but also a big chunk was just all around the lap in the corners.
“That's why I just kept pushing until the end and that's why I had to lock up on the last lap into Turn 1.

“But yeah, the main thing was we saw already in practice that I was lacking pace. I couldn't carry the same speed through the corners as Checo, so we changed a lot for the qualifying, including some dampers and the floor, and it actually felt a lot better.

“But then the ride again during the race degraded quite a lot... Again, we've changed a lot of things, so I think it's something to do with dampers degging with heat, the floor... We are still lacking a bit of pressure tappings here and there, so we still don't have the full information on aero parts that I'm used to from the past.

“You can immediately see if you're down or up, but now there are some bits of the floor where we are blind. But for me, feeling-wise, it was more the ride - that, in combination with the power steering that was degging throughout the weekend. So I was really then also struggling to feel the car throughout the race.
“So those things combined. And then the [power unit] difference was probably bigger than we thought, at least from the data.
“We've got a number in theory, but that's new engine versus new one, of the new and old spec. So yeah, I think those combined. I was pretty slow.”
The power unit difference is in reference to Perez having the upgraded ADUO 2 Ferrari engine in Baku while Bottas doesn’t yet have it.
This was previously described as a “small difference”, but as Bottas says the upgrade may be more powerful than first thought.
Bottas says it’s “50/50” if his ADUO 2 engine arrives in time for him to run it at Sepang; if not, he’ll have to wait until next week in Singapore.
Team-mate Perez won’t be running it this weekend, swapping to a different power unit in his pool in order to save it for a weekend when it will be more beneficial.
“We took a decision where we feel we got the best shot at it,” Perez explained.
“That's why we're taking a bit of a hit here. But we hope that it will pay us back.
“We are not too optimistic about this weekend. So we decided to save it.”
As Perez alluded, the Cadillac drivers are braced for a difficult weekend because Sepang poses two challenges the Cadillac struggles with in particular: tyre overheating and high-speed corners.
As Perez explains, the Cadillac has “a massive lack of load in the car and a lot of drag” right now.
“In Baku, I basically stayed on the overtake mode for the entire race and therefore I was able to stay with the others,” Perez said.
“But when I overtook them, I was just a passenger because I had no straightline speed. So we have two big issues: load and a lot of drag.
“But we always knew this first year was going to be tricky.”
keyPointsZh: 博塔斯的最快单圈也比佩雷兹慢1.489秒
他因驶入1号弯逃生通道导致能量输出模式混乱，15号弯后刹车失灵撞上护墙
佩雷兹在博塔斯撞车前几乎已经套圈
keyPointsEn: Bottas's fastest single lap was still 1.489s slower than Perez's
His car's deployment pattern got confused after he took the Turn 1 escape road, leaving his rear brakes without effect at Turn 15 where he nosed into the barriers
Perez was close to lapping Bottas before the Finn's crash on the final lap

relatedItems.titleZh: 奥孔与哈斯关系破裂的多重原因
relatedItems.summaryZh: 埃斯特班·奥孔离开哈斯车队时再度提及“超出自己控制的因素”，暗示这段车手与车队关系的逐渐恶化。哈斯早在夏休期后便通知奥孔大概率不会留队，而法拉利支持的青训车手拉法·卡马拉被认为是接替他的热门人选。
relatedItems.originalTitle: All the reasons the Ocon-Haas relationship fell apart
relatedItems.summaryEn: Esteban Ocon marked his exit from Haas with another reference to elements beyond his control, hinting at a gradual deterioration of the driver-team relationship. Haas decided long ago not to activate its contractual option and informed Ocon shortly after the summer break that he was unlikely to be retained.
keyPointsZh: 哈斯拥有下赛季保留奥孔的合同选择权，但早已决定不激活，并在夏休期后不久通知了他。
法拉利支持的拉法·卡马拉是最热门的接替人选，有人推测是法拉利对其青训车手的支持将奥孔挤出车门。
签约时奥孔是哈斯自2016年车队成立赛季引进罗曼·格罗斯让以来拥有的最成功车手。
keyPointsEn: Haas had a contractual option to retain Ocon for next year, decided long ago not to activate it, and notified him shortly after the summer break.
Ferrari-backed Rafa Camara is the favourite to replace Ocon, leading some to infer Ferrari's support of its junior driver is pushing Ocon out.
When signed, Ocon was the most successful driver Haas had employed since Romain Grosjean, a 10-time podium finisher who joined for the team's inaugural 2016 season.

relatedItems.summaryEn: Formula 1 will return to Sepang in 2026 after nearly a decade away, replacing the cancelled Bahrain and Saudi Arabian Grands Prix, and drivers have been sharing their early predictions about the challenge ahead.
